game_title: Stamina Climb – Moss Door Chamber Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stamina value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
